folds.title: The API
points: An **API** lets a program talk to Claude directly, with no chat window.
Developers use it to put Claude inside their own apps and tools.
You need an account and a key to use it.

folds.title: Messages
points: The main job: send **messages** to Claude and get a reply back.
The apps you use are different products.
But the idea is the same: you send text, Claude answers.

folds.title: Tool use
points: **Tool use** lets Claude ask for help.
You describe a tool, such as a weather lookup.
Claude decides when it is needed and returns a structured request for it.

folds.title: Who runs the tool?
points: Claude does not run your tool itself.
The app runs it and sends the result back.
Some tools, like web search, are run for you.

folds.title: The weather loop
points: **You:** "Do I need an umbrella in Oslo today?"
**Claude:** asks to use the weather tool.
**The app:** runs it and sends back "rain".
folds.note: This loop is why Claude can seem to check things.

folds.prompt: Put the tool use loop in order.

parts.label: Ask
parts.text: You ask a question that needs outside data

parts.label: Request
parts.text: Claude returns a request to use a tool

parts.label: Run
parts.text: The app runs the tool and gets a result

parts.label: Answer
parts.text: Claude uses the result to reply
